title: Link expiry controls
objective: Add expiry controls to share links. PATCH /api/documents/:id/links/:linkId accepts expiresAt (an ISO time after the store clock, or null to clear; anything else is 400 { error: 'invalid_expiry' }) and maxOpens (a whole number of at least 1, or null; anything else is 400 { error: 'invalid_max_opens' }); members only (404 otherwise). From expiresAt on, or once the link has been opened maxOpens times, GET /l/:linkId and its download answer 410 { error: 'expired' } with nothing about the document and no open counted; the visitor page reads "This link has expired" (data-testid="expired"). With maxOpens 2, two opens work and the third is refused. On the document page each link row shows its limits, like "Expires Oct 5" and "1 of 5 opens".
acceptance: Members set and clear an expiry time and an open limit, with validation
After the expiry time the link answers 410 and counts nothing
The open limit allows exactly that many opens
The visitor page says the link has expired
The document page shows each link's limits
plan_summary: expiresAt and maxOpens on links (a schema change), a PATCH route, a gate in the visitor routes and linkPage, limits on the document page.
